name.zh: Oh Story（网文写作 skill 包）

tagline.en: Turn a coding agent into a complete web-fiction writing workflow — chart scanning, deconstruction, drafting, de-AI editing, covers.
tagline.zh: 把编程 Agent 变成完整的网文写作流程——扫榜、拆文、写作、去AI味、封面图。

definition.en: Oh Story is an MIT-licensed creative-writing skill pack for Claude Code and other supported agent hosts. Its 13 skills cover web-fiction research, deconstruction, long-form serials, short stories, revision and covers. It combines writing instructions with chapter blueprints, deterministic checks and file-based project state; it is not a hosted model or a finished-novel guarantee. `/story-setup` configures the host. Specialist-agent orchestration depends on host capabilities, with direct execution available when those capabilities are missing.
definition.zh: 用 Claude Code 写网文可以使用 Oh Story：这是 MIT 开源的创意写作 skill 包，也适配其他受支持的 Agent 宿主。13 个 skills 覆盖选题、拆文、长篇连载、短篇、修订与封面，把写作指令与逐章细纲、确定性检查和文件化项目状态结合起来；它不是托管模型，也不保证直接产出可发表的整本小说。`/story-setup` 负责配置宿主，专业 agent 编排取决于宿主能力，能力缺失时可直接执行。

en: How do I continue a manuscript I have already written?

Use story-import for a continuable project, then separate reconstructed history from the next chapter you choose to write. The [harbor-radio handoff example](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/import-and-continue) preserves a promise, an already-made decision and unequal character knowledge without inventing a successful repair or complete reconciliation. Old prose stays intact; a future outline is not a completed event.
How do I start writing in Claude Code?

After installing the pack, run `/story-setup` in your writing-project folder and open a fresh session. Use `/story` to describe your task rather than memorizing every skill. For a new long-form project, `/story-long-write 帮我开书` prepares settings, an outline and chapter blueprints, then stops before prose by default. Review that plan, then request `/story-long-write 写第1章`. This is the agent-host workflow, not a login to the separate hosted ZenStory workbench. “No prose” still creates planning files; tracking is initialized after the outline stage is complete. For a chat-only proposal or a clear plan-to-draft handoff, see [the writer’s skill guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers). For a detailed character profile that still does not generate action, [character motivation](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/character-motivation) moves from a relay plan into an original scene of resistance and shared credit, without treating an agreement as a completed delivery.
Can one premise become a complete short story rather than a serial opening?

Choose a central question and the action that answers it, then write the development that earns the ending. The [original repair-shop plan and prose excerpts](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/short-story-from-idea) move from failed hinting to stated terms, an accepted deposit and departure. A promise to dispatch on Wednesday neither guarantees an arrival date nor means the repair is already done; a settled agreement does not heal every family hurt. Separate the six-section design, illustrative excerpts and the later complete manuscript file.
扫榜 · chart scanning
Collect supported platform data when available, accept creator-supplied samples, or explicitly label historical knowledge fallback; unavailable sources can be skipped.
How do I learn from a novel without copying its plot?

Separate source observations, possible interpretations and a new-story exercise. The [original passage-analysis example](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/learn-from-fiction) traces an unsigned poster proof to a conditional next step, then compares two garden scenes with the same facts and outcome: accepting a limit and sharing the explanation, or rejecting an unconfirmed staffing workaround. An original prose version then tests the uncertain-help option in dialogue and carries out the smaller order without copying the poster’s gestures. The guide also distinguishes the first-three-chapter checkpoint, a stated partial-reading scope and progress-based resume. Analysis-only work is not a continuable import, and a completed processing batch is not a full-novel verdict.
How can I reduce character drift across many chapters?

Separate the author’s private truth, each character’s own knowledge and what the reader has seen. Carry relevant current state, active clues and the next chapter’s commitments from the same project. The [original letter-and-deadline example](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/long-novel-continuity) adds an optional clue-payoff design: a plausible suspicion remains a suspicion, later evidence has a prepared source, and a new address changes the next action without making an undelivered letter delivered.
What if a chapter contradicts an established fact?

Identify the conflicting passage and the intended fact, then request `/story-long-write 修改第N章` with that evidence. If the revision changes continuity facts, the documented workflow requires a same-chapter revision transaction through `tracking_commit.py`; do not hand-edit the derived context or snapshots. Review the corrected prose and state before continuing. Structural checks do not replace the author’s judgment about characterization, voice or literary quality.
Should I apply every conflicting review suggestion?

No. Connect feedback to passage evidence and this book’s constraints, then choose the repair rather than accepting every proposed plot change. The [original review-to-revision example](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/review-and-revise) turns an accepted agency diagnosis into a transfer-slip scene: the protagonist compares evidence and resists delay without breaking the seal or revealing the culprit. It separates agreement from completed registration and makes later-chapter attribution checks concrete.
Why does a detailed outline still become flat prose?

An outline names the required change; prose makes the decision and response happen. The [original library-rescue example](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/outline-to-chapter) now pairs a staged opening with a continuation from the signed form through conditional cooperation and the first trip’s aftermath. It shows where to slow down, where a short transition is enough, and why stopping early requires an agreed chapter boundary—not an invented twist or a claim that a chat sample is a saved chapter.
How can I revise formulaic prose without changing the story?

Name the wording problem and preserve the scene’s facts, useful details and chosen cadence. A pattern hit needs contextual judgment, not an authorship verdict. The [original prose-revision comparisons](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/revise-ai-prose) show a restrained edit, a connected-cadence alternative, purposeful repetition and the difference between losing a scene detail and changing an action. Pasted-fragment revision is distinct from detection only and in-place file editing.
How can continuation keep my voice instead of a generic style?

Give an authorized sample and name the useful dimensions, while keeping this book’s facts and viewpoint separate. The [original author-voice example](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/preserve-author-voice) preserves a longer rhythm and mild humor without importing another story’s characters. Sample inference is not confirmed memory; a temporary choice, book-specific preference and global habit have different scopes.
How can characters sound different without relying on catchphrases?

Give each speaker an immediate goal, a knowledge boundary and a relationship to the listener, then choose the wording. The [original rehearsal dialogue example](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/character-dialogue) separates three conversational agendas while preserving the same outcome and an undisclosed private fact. Character dialogue can change with the listener without replacing the book’s narrative voice.
Covers
Prepare genre-aware cover guidance and use an available image-generation tool when configured.
zh: 已经写了十几章，怎么接着写？
先用 story-import 建立可续写工程，再把反推前史与作者选定的下一章分开。[海港收音机交接示例](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/import-and-continue)保留一个承诺、已经作出的决定与不同人物的知情范围，不补猜修理成功或彻底和解。旧正文不动，未来细纲也不是已发生事件。
Claude Code 装好后，怎么开始写小说？

安装 skill 包后，在写作项目目录运行 `/story-setup`，再新开会话。通过 `/story` 描述任务，不必先记住全部 skill。新建长篇可以说 `/story-long-write 帮我开书`：默认先生成设定、大纲与细纲，在正文前停下。审阅规划后，再明确请求 `/story-long-write 写第1章`。这是 Agent 宿主内的流程，不是登录另一个产品 ZenStory 网页工作台。 “不写正文”仍会建立规划文件；大纲阶段完成后才初始化追踪状态。只想在聊天里看提案，或想划清规划到正文的交接点，可以看[作者 Skill 指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers)。 如果人设很完整、人物却不行动，[人物动机指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/character-motivation)从中继规划写到争取、抵抗与分享功劳的原创场景，不把达成约定当成已完成送达。
只有一个梗，怎么写成完整短篇而不是连载开头？
先选一个核心问题和能用行动回答它的结尾，再写出让变化成立的过程。[原创修补店规划与正文节选](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/short-story-from-idea)从暗示无效写到说清条件、付下定金与离开。约定周三寄出，不代表当日送达，更不代表此刻已经修好；约定落定也不等于一家人的旧伤全好了。六节设计、示范节选与后续完整正文文件要分开。
扫榜
在条件允许时采集所支持平台的数据，接受作者提供的样本，或明确标注历史知识回退；不可用的数据源可以跳过。
怎样拆小说，才能学到写法而不照搬情节？

分开原文观察、可选解释和新故事练习。[原创片段精读示例](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/learn-from-fiction)从未签的海报校样读出有条件的下一步，再比较事实与结果相同的两套菜园场景：接纳限制并共同承担解释，或放下尚未成立的人手补救。再用原创正文让人手补救在交谈中受检验、让较小订单实际落定，不照搬海报里的动作。指南也区分前三章停靠、明确范围的局部精读和按进度续跑。只做拆文不是导入可续写工程，处理完一个批次也不是已经得到全书结论。
长篇续写怎样减少人设和情节漂移？
分开作者私下的真相、各角色本人已知和读者已经看到的内容。从同一项目带上相关人物现状、活跃伏笔与下一章承诺。[原创退信与期限示例](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/long-novel-continuity)补充一条可选回收设计：合理怀疑仍是怀疑，后续证据先有来源，新地址改变下一步行动，却不会把尚未交出的信变成已送达。
发现某一章与既有设定冲突怎么办？
先指出冲突段落和希望保留的事实，再带着依据请求 `/story-long-write 修改第N章`。修订若改变连续性事实，文档规定通过 `tracking_commit.py` 提交同章修订事务，不要手改派生上下文或角色快照。继续写之前核对改后的正文与状态。结构检查不能代替作者对人设、文风和文学质量的判断。
审稿意见互相矛盾，是不是都要改？
不必照单全改。先让意见回到段落证据与本书约束，再选择修法，不接受每项附带的剧情改变。[原创审稿到改稿示例](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/review-and-revise)把“增强主角主动性”写成移交单场景：由她核对证据、坚持先登记编号差异，不靠拆封或提前揭底。示例也分清谈妥登记与登记完成，并具体说明后文发现者归属该怎样检查。
有细纲，为什么写出来仍像剧情复述？
细纲列出必须发生的变化，正文则把决定与回应真正写出来。[原创搬书库示例](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/outline-to-chapter)从开场对照继续写到签字后的有条件合作与首趟结束，展示哪里应展开、哪里可以简短过渡。提前收章须先改定章界，不靠新增反转补强，也不把聊天试段当作已保存章节。
怎么改掉正文的套话和解释腔？
先说清措辞问题，保留场景事实、有功能的细节和选定的节奏。模式命中需要语境判断，不是作者身份结论。[原创改稿对照](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/revise-ai-prose)比较克制写法与连贯句式，说明哪些重复值得留，以及删丢场景细节和改掉动作有什么不同。粘贴片段修订、只检测和文件原位修改也分别说明。
怎么保留我的文风，而不是越改越像统一模板？
提供有权使用的样本，说清哪些表达维度有用，再分开本书事实与视角。[原创文风示例](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/preserve-author-voice)保留较长节奏与轻微调侃，却不搬入另一个故事的人物。样本推断不等于已确认记忆；本段选择、本书偏好与全局习惯的范围不同。
怎样让人物对白不同，而不只给每人添口头禅？
先分眼前目标、信息边界与听者关系，再选措辞。[原创排练对白示例](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/character-dialogue)区分三人的对话议程，同时保留既定结果与尚未公开的私人事实。人物可以因听者不同而改变说法，不必把整本书的叙述声音一并换掉。
封面
准备题材相关的封面指引，并在配置可用生图工具时调用。

en: Local verifiers check contracts and detectable patterns, rather than assigning literary quality scores.
Project settings, outlines, drafts, references and tracking remain inspectable files.
Host-aware setup can use specialist roles or a direct fallback; supported hosts do not imply identical orchestration.
The repository includes deconstruction, continuation and cover examples, not a guarantee of comparable results.
zh: 本地 verifier 检查契约与可检测模式，不为文学质量打分。
设定、大纲、正文、参考资料与追踪记录均为可检查的文件。
按宿主能力使用专业角色或直接执行回退；支持某个宿主不代表编排能力完全相同。
仓库包含拆文、续写与封面示例，不保证复现同等结果。

tagline.en: Develop ideas or source stories into episode scripts, visual specifications, storyboards and generation prompts, with optional production and review.
tagline.zh: 把点子或原著发展为分集剧本、视觉设定、分镜和生成提示词，按需进入制作与审查。

definition.en: Drama Skills is an eleven-skill workflow for AI short-drama and motion-comic creation in agent hosts such as Claude Code and Codex. Creators can enter at the stage their material needs: development, writing, assets, storyboards, prompts, production, editing or review. Documents are created as needed; prompt/specification work is distinct from generating media, which requires configured providers and explicit spending confirmation.
definition.zh: Drama Skills 是面向 Claude Code、Codex 等 Agent 宿主的 11-skill AI 短剧与漫剧创作工作流。创作者可按材料需要进入开发、写作、资产、分镜、提示词、制作、剪辑或审查阶段。文档按需创建；提示词与规格设计不同于媒体生成，后者需要配置供应商并明确确认消费。

en: Does one novel chapter become one short-drama episode?

Not by default. Plan around a local dramatic result and a clear handoff, preserving source facts and marking proposed changes. When combining episodes, retain what changes the character’s judgment and the visible consequence of the choice, not every recap or break. The [novel-to-short-drama guide](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/novel-to-short-drama) compares one-episode and three-episode cuts of an original repair-shop story, alongside its prose-to-scene-and-shots example.
Develop
Create an episode map or genre guidance when needed; a candidate director brief becomes authority only after creator acceptance.
How can I improve dialogue without changing the story?

Give each speaker something to seek from the other person, and keep the facts that make the choice understandable. The [repair-shop dialogue revision](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/novel-to-short-drama) changes how the mother challenges an unaffordable promise without inventing funds or removing the daughter’s decision. It preserves the existing scene and later handover; direct answers need not become riddles.
Can I storyboard an already accepted screenplay directly?

Yes: start from the current screenplay and necessary visual facts, without restarting development or waiting for image prompts. The [script-to-storyboard guide](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/script-to-storyboard) follows an original scene through four shot designs, preserving dialogue, handoffs and the ending. It explains what to change when complete speech and sequential actions do not fit the planned duration; its timings are text estimates, not measured footage. A same-script four-shot versus continuous two-shot study also shows how framing changes attention, without treating more cuts or a long take as automatically better.
Can I save a reveal for the ending just by hiding it in the picture?

Not if the dialogue already gives it away. The [screenplay-to-storyboard example](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/script-to-storyboard) tracks what the audience first hears or sees, then compares keeping the accepted scene with an explicitly proposed ending-reveal rewrite. Moving the line changes the cause of a response and the ending; it is not a silent camera adjustment. Any chosen subtitles or start frames must follow that same information order.
How do I keep the same character across shots?

Separate persistent identity from the scene’s compatible Look and each shot’s changing hand, prop and gaze state. Carry only the necessary unchanged visual facts as continuity locks. The [three-shot character example](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/character-consistency) shows the handoff without pretending a character sheet guarantees generated faces.
Are prompt IDs already image references?

No. `IMG-*` identifies prompt text; `REF-*` binds an inspected real project file. An external `PLAN-*` points to a current IMG or SHOT entry, not a made-up image path, and can support requested video-prompt writing before the creator attaches pictures in their own canvas. It cannot supply files to `short-drama-produce`. The [reference-selection exercise](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/character-consistency) separates visible identity, compatible clothing, geography and boundary frames without requiring every supplied picture to be regenerated.
Produce, edit, review
Media generation uses prepare → explicit confirmation → run. Editing and a separately requested review are distinct stages.
zh: 小说改短剧，是不是一章对应一集？
不是默认一一对应。按局部戏剧结果与明确交接来分集，保留原文事实，并标清拟改内容。合并集数时，要保住改变人物判断的信息与选择的可见后果，不必保留每次回顾或断点。[小说改短剧指南](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/novel-to-short-drama)用原创维修铺故事比较一集与三集切法，并演示从叙述到场次、镜头的转换。
开发
按需创建分集地图或题材指引；候选导演阐述经创作者接受后才成为权威。
怎样改好短剧对白，又不把故事改掉？
先明确每个说话者想争取什么，并保留让决定可理解的事实。[维修铺对白改稿](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/novel-to-short-drama)改变母亲面对勉强许诺时的回应，不新增资金，也不替女儿作决定。沿用现有场景和后续交钟；必要的直白回答不必都改成谜语。
已经确认的剧本，可以直接做分镜吗？

可以从当前剧本与必要视觉事实进入，不必重做开发，也不必等待图片提示词。[剧本到分镜指南](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/script-to-storyboard)用原创场景展示四镜设计，保留对白、动作交接与结尾，并说明完整发声和顺序动作装不下时该改哪一层；示例时长是文本估计，不是实测视频。 另用同一剧本比较四镜与连续双人镜怎样分配注意，不把切得多或长镜当成天然更好。
想把信息留到结尾揭晓，只在画面里藏住就够了吗？
若对白已经说破，就不够。[剧本到分镜示例](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/script-to-storyboard)逐镜说明观众先听到或看到什么，再比较保留原场与明确提出结尾揭晓改稿。移走一句话可能改变反应的原因和结尾，不能冒充只调机位；若采用字幕或起始帧，也要服从同一信息顺序。
同一角色跨镜头，怎样减少外观和动作串线？
分开长期人物身份、本场相容造型，以及每镜变化的手位、道具和视线；只有必要且不变的可见事实才作为连续性锁传递。[原创三镜示例](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/character-consistency)展示具体交接，不把角色设定表当成生成脸部一致的保证。
有提示词编号，就算已经有参考图了吗？

不是。`IMG-*` 标记提示词，`REF-*` 绑定已检查的项目内真实文件；外部 `PLAN-*` 指向当前 IMG 或 SHOT 条目，不是虚构图片路径。创作者可以先按完整计划请求视频提示词，再在自己的画布挂图，但计划不能向 `short-drama-produce` 提供文件。[挑图与挂图示例](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/character-consistency)区分可见身份、相容造型、地理与边界帧，不要求每张已有图都重新生成。
制作、剪辑、审查
媒体生成遵循准备 → 明确确认 → 执行。剪辑与另行请求的审查是独立阶段。

definition.en: Novel to Game is a seven-skill workflow for Claude Code, Codex and Kimi Code. It builds a cited source bible, compares adaptation concepts, designs the game and art direction, and builds a candidate for an explicitly chosen target runtime. Its QA contract records evidence for launch, rendering, input, the core loop, an outcome and restart; it does not certify fun, balance or readiness for commercial release.

en: Can I make an interactive story rather than a combat game?
Yes: set a narrative-led experience in the brief and concept. Decisions can change testimony, what characters know and later scenes; they need not be disguised as cards, turns or an affinity meter.
How do choices change more than the wording?

Make important actions readable before selection and show their consequences in scene prose, not only state labels. The [original ferry example](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/meaningful-choices) writes advance information, a separate consent exchange and three closing passages for two decision points. Expressive wording can remain flavor; do not promise another ending or a hidden score for every line.
What may I change from the novel?

Keep cited source facts and uncertainties in `analysis/SOURCE_BIBLE.md`. Separate approved adaptation additions from evidence; do not let implementation silently rewrite the agreed brief or source bible.
How much should I adapt first?

Choose a source range explicitly, then one player role, a concrete objective and an outcome that preserves the intended experience. A small build does not excuse missing source coverage for a requested whole-book adaptation. The [worked slice-selection brief](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/quick-start) compares a summary, a bounded ferry decision and an expanded town scope; game-world-design then specifies the selected slice before full art production.
What do I receive, and what remains unproven?

The [quick start](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/quick-start) explains the brief, design files and built candidate. Design-only work is not a playable game. The six runtime checks cover the recorded run; they do not establish every branch, subjective quality or commercial readiness.
How should I revise my first game candidate?

Describe the exact choice or scene, your input, what you expected and what appeared. The [ferry candidate-feedback examples](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/quick-start) distinguish a misleading refusal label, a displayed ending versus a wrong state transition, and an author-requested rule change. Keep approved facts and untouched design decisions; a scoped revision is not a reason to regenerate the whole concept.
zh: 我想做互动文游，不想做战斗游戏，可以吗？
可以，在简报与概念阶段选择叙事主导体验。决定可以改变证词、人物知道的信息和后续场景，不必包装成卡牌、回合或好感度条。
怎样避免选择只换一句文案？
让关键行动在点选前可理解，再用场景文案兑现后果，不只列状态值。[原创渡口示例](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/meaningful-choices)为两个选择点写出事前信息、单独的同意确认与三段收束。单纯表达语气的选项可以保留，但不必为每句话承诺新结局或隐藏分数。
原著可以改到什么程度？
在 `analysis/SOURCE_BIBLE.md` 保留带出处的事实和疑点，把批准的改编新增设定与原文证据分开。实现阶段不能悄悄改写已确定的产品简报或原著圣经。
第一次应该改编多大范围？
先明确来源范围，再选一个玩家身份、具体目标与能保住体验承诺的结果。首版做得小，不代表已经要求的全书改编可以跳过来源覆盖。[切片选择简报示例](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/quick-start)比较只读梗概、一次渡口决定和整城扩展；选定后，再由 game-world-design 在完整美术生产前明确切片设计。
最后会拿到什么，什么还不能证明？
[完整入门指南](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/quick-start)说明简报、设计文件与构建候选版本。只做设计不等于可玩游戏。六项运行检查只覆盖所记录的一次运行，不代表每条分支、主观质量或商业发布准备程度都已通过。
拿到第一个游戏候选版本后，该怎样继续改？
点名具体选项或场景，说明输入、期待与实际表现。[渡口候选反馈示例](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/quick-start)分清误导性的拒绝标签、结尾显示与状态转换的差异，以及作者新提出的规则。保留已确认事实与未点名的设计，有范围的修改不等于重新生成整个概念。

en: How do I turn a local video into a Chinese recap?

Build a scene/dialogue evidence index, choose the audience promise, divide the work between pictures, original audio and narration, then voice and assemble the grounded script. The [complete workflow guide](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/video-to-narration) explains full/cut choices, stage handoffs and expected files before optional draft export.
Can I add narration when the source has none?

Yes. No narration does not mean no dialogue; preserve speech evidence when people speak. Dialogue-free footage can skip ASR while still using remote VLM analysis. The [original evidence-to-script examples](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/video-to-narration) distinguish a changed on-screen promise from a proven result, then show what can be said when only the initial attempts are available. When later footage is missing, request that evidence or propose a clearly narrower account; do not invent an ending.
Which moments should keep their original sound?

Let a complete original line, a revealing action sound or a meaningful wait lead, then ask what supported information narration adds. The [five-beat radio example](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/original-audio-and-narration) compares shortening a context sentence with removing it: do not replace reluctance with invented poverty, erase the no-response interval, or call a text revision a completed mix.
Can I write the recap before choosing the cut?

Decide the story and sound roles first. In the orchestrated cut flow, select source clips, then write narration against the actual edited output timeline. Do not copy original timestamps into that output-time narration.
What if the voiceover is too long?
Reduce or move the thought instead of speaking over the next protected line. Bounded speed adjustment is not unlimited; an unsafe fit can block placement rather than clipping the spoken ending.
Does an audio-owner label automatically preserve the mix?

No. The renderer does not parse the creative board. Actual narration timing, speech evidence and mix settings implement the plan; source audio can remain ducked beyond the written block until a safe recovery point. Listen to the rendered handoff.
Can I finish the sound and captions manually?

Export the existing timeline, then choose what the scene needs. The [JianYing / CapCut guide](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/capcut-draft) compares two original rehearsal edits: move commentary after the result, or remove it for an original-audio-led cut. Move matching captions and inspect the old and new volume keyframes; moving only a voiceover does not move every dependent element.
zh: 怎样把本地视频做成中文解说？
先建立场景与对白证据索引，再确定观众承诺，分配画面、原声与旁白的职责，之后为有依据的文案配音、合成。[完整流程指南](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/video-to-narration)说明 full/cut 选择、阶段交接和预期文件，再按需导出草稿。
原片没有旁白，可以看画面生成解说吗？
可以。没有旁白不等于没有对白，人物说话时仍应保留对白证据；确无对白时可跳过 ASR，但仍需远程 VLM 分析。[原创证据到文案示例](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/video-to-narration)分清改写书面承诺与证实结果，再展示只拿到起初尝试时能说什么。缺少后续画面，应补要证据或明确提出较窄方案，不编造结尾。
哪些地方应该保留原声？
让完整原话、揭示变化的动作声或有意义的等待主导，再判断旁白是否增加有依据的信息。[收音机五拍示例](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/original-audio-and-narration)比较缩短一句背景与去掉它的不同代价：不把不舍改成没钱，不因少说一句就删掉没有响应的等待，也不把文字修订当作已完成混音。
可以先写好旁白，再随便剪画面吗？
先明确故事与声音职责。编排式 cut 流程先选原片片段，再针对实际剪后输出时间线写旁白，不能直接把原片时间戳抄进输出时间的旁白稿。
配音太长，放不进窗口怎么办？
先删减或移动这段意思，不要抢下一句须保留原话的位置。受限变速不等于无限加速；无法安全放入时可阻断放置，而不是裁掉尾音。
写了声音职责标签，就能自动保住原声吗？
不能。渲染器不解析创意 board，需要实际旁白时间、对白证据与混音设置落实；原声可能在书面段落结束后仍被压低，直到安全恢复点。要听渲染后的真实交接。
可以再手动精修声音和字幕吗？
先导出已有时间轴，再选择这场戏需要什么。[剪映 / CapCut 指南](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/capcut-draft)比较两种原创排练剪法：把解说移到结果后，或去掉解说做原声主导的短版。对应字幕要一起处理，旧位置与新位置的音量关键帧也要检查；只移动旁白，不等于所有相关元素都会跟着移动。

definition.en: Oh Story DSH is a community plugin for DeepSeek Harness that bundles pinned versions of Oh Story, Drama Skills, Novel to Game and Video Recap Skills, with novel, short-drama, game and video workbenches. It runs in a local DSH environment, whose model and media services need separate configuration; it is not an offline model bundle. The plugin package is `@oh-story/dsh`. It is not affiliated with, partnered with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

Follow the versioned installation guide: Node.js 24+, pnpm-assisted plugin installation in a DSH Web profile, then start DSH Web. Installing the creation plugin alone does not add a Web UI to a fresh profile.

Configure a model for AI creation and only the media providers you use. Video processing additionally requires Python and ffmpeg/ffprobe.
Open
Choose a workspace and session. Creation tabs appear when project files exist; an empty workspace retains native DSH Chat.
Continue an existing draft

Use the [DeepSeek fiction guide](https://zenstory.ai/dsh/deepseek-novel-writing) to distinguish a complete chapter from an unfinished tail, compare next-scene choices and separate Chat-only discussion from import or manuscript changes.

definition.en: ZenStory is the hosted, conversation-first member of the family: a three-panel workbench (file tree, editor, AI chat) where outlines, drafts, characters and lore are files, and a multi-agent backend drafts, suggests and revises against them. It ships its own skills and an Agent API for Claude Code and OpenClaw, is self-hostable (MIT), and is available as a service at app.zenstory.ai with free and paid plans.
definition.zh: ZenStory 是这个家族里托管的、对话优先的成员：三栏工作台（文件树、编辑器、AI 对话），大纲、草稿、人设、世界观都是文件，多 agent 后端围绕它们写作、建议与修订。自带 skills 与面向 Claude Code / OpenClaw 的 Agent API，可自托管（MIT），也提供 app.zenstory.ai 的在线服务与免费/付费方案。

en: How do I start writing in the browser?

Open the [workbench Dashboard](https://app.zenstory.ai/dashboard), choose an available project type and create it with or without an idea. For a deliberate first request, leave the idea blank and then ask for an outline in chat. Follow the [short quick start](https://zenstory.ai/docs/getting-started/quick-start); no coding-agent installation is required.
How do I turn an idea into my first scene?

Separate approved facts from open decisions, save characters and a scene plan, then draft into a named file. The [first-story walkthrough](https://zenstory.ai/docs/getting-started/first-project) includes an original lost-property premise, file plan and three scoped requests, not a recorded model run.
How do I revise without changing the whole story?

Open the target file, name the references to read and quote the passage. Attach material items when relevant. The [AI assistant guide](https://zenstory.ai/docs/user-guide/ai-assistant) explains context and continuation; the [editor guide](https://zenstory.ai/docs/user-guide/editor) shows a local before/after revision. An instruction to suggest changes is not enforced read-only mode, and file operations do not all use per-change approval.
Can I take the manuscript out of the workbench?

The [manuscript export guide](https://zenstory.ai/docs/user-guide/export) explains combined TXT from saved draft/script files, chapter ordering and a separate review copy. It is not a backup of characters, materials, chat or history. Use the [version guide](https://zenstory.ai/docs/user-guide/version-history) to distinguish file recovery from project snapshots; keep important originals independently.
Will AI Memory keep every character consistent?

AI Memory is a four-field project summary, not proof that the model reads every file or a guarantee against drift. Keep confirmed settings, saved-scene progress and undecided ideas separate. The [worked memory guide](https://zenstory.ai/docs/advanced/ai-memory) shows what to save, how context limits matter and how to correct a wrong summary without silently rewriting the manuscript.
Must I split every chapter into many prompts?

No fixed prompt count is required. You can request a complete chapter when its decisions, evidence and stopping point are clear; unresolved motives may need discussion first. The [writing-handoff workflow](https://zenstory.ai/docs/advanced/workflow-tips) follows one scene from accepted design through prose, local revision and a saved-state handoff, without promising a particular writing speed.
How do I turn reference analysis into my own scene?

Locate a choice in the source, separate evidence from interpretation, then decide what changes in your own characters' actions and costs. The [original material-analysis walkthrough](https://zenstory.ai/docs/advanced/material-analysis) moves from a recording passage to a different toy-car practice scene, not just renamed props. The [materials introduction](https://zenstory.ai/docs/user-guide/materials) covers TXT limits, asynchronous analysis and explicit chat attachments; uploading a book does not put it all into every conversation.
zh: 不用编程 Agent，怎样在网页里开始写作？
打开[工作台 Dashboard](https://app.zenstory.ai/dashboard)，选择可用项目类型，可以带灵感创建，也可以留空后自己发送第一条构思请求。[快速入门](https://zenstory.ai/docs/getting-started/quick-start)给出这条短路径，不需要先安装编程 Agent。
怎样把一个点子变成第一场正文？
先区分确定事实与待定决定，保存人物和场景提纲，再写入指定正文文件。[第一篇短篇教程](https://zenstory.ai/docs/getting-started/first-project)提供原创失物招领故事、文件安排和三段范围明确的请求；示例不是实际模型运行记录。
怎样局部改稿，不把整篇故事改掉？
打开目标文件，命名需要读取的依据，引用问题段落；相关素材可附加到对话。[AI 创作助手](https://zenstory.ai/docs/user-guide/ai-assistant)说明上下文与接续，[编辑器指南](https://zenstory.ai/docs/user-guide/editor)给出局部修改前后对照。“只给建议”不是强制只读模式，也不是所有文件操作都有逐项批准界面。
能把作品带出工作台吗？
[稿件导出指南](https://zenstory.ai/docs/user-guide/export)说明已保存正文与剧本的 TXT 合并、章节排序和另存送审副本；这不是包含人物、素材、聊天和历史的完整备份。[版本指南](https://zenstory.ai/docs/user-guide/version-history)区分单文件恢复与项目快照，重要原稿仍需独立保留。
AI 记忆能保证长篇不崩人设吗？
AI 记忆是四字段项目摘要，不证明每轮都读完全部文件，也不保证不会写偏。分开已确认设定、已写进度与待定想法。[记忆填写与更正示例](https://zenstory.ai/docs/advanced/ai-memory)说明怎样保存、上下文为什么有限，以及如何纠正摘要而不悄悄重写正文。
写一章必须拆成很多轮提示词吗？
没有固定轮数。决定、依据和停止点明确时，可以请求完整章节；动机尚未确定时，先讨论这个关键选择。[写作接续流程](https://zenstory.ai/docs/advanced/workflow-tips)用一场戏连起已选设计、正文、局部修改与实际保存状态，不承诺固定写作速度。
分析完参考小说，怎样写出自己的场景？

先从原文定位人物选择，分开依据与解读，再决定自己角色的行动和代价。[素材分析原创示例](https://zenstory.ai/docs/advanced/material-analysis)从录音片段走到不同的小车练习场景，不只是换人名与道具。[素材库入门](https://zenstory.ai/docs/user-guide/materials)说明 TXT 限制、异步分析与显式附加；上传一本书，不等于每轮对话都读完它。
